notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 11.
description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Thopter Foundry trigger, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Thopter and Treasure.
When the Thopter dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
